business_problem: Since beginning their turnaround in 2021, Frontier has transformed from a legacy telephone company into the largest pure-play fiber internet provider in the country. As part of their transformation, Frontier needed to become a more digital, efficient technology company powered by data.
solution_summary: Frontier Communications is focused on advancing their purpose of Building Gigabit America — growing their fiber network to connect more people to their fiber technology and all the opportunities it enables. In support of their fiber-first strategy, Frontier turned to the Databricks Data + AI Platform to modernize their data foundation. With trusted, real-time insights at their fingertips, teams across the organization are accelerating innovation — from AI-powered sales and automated contract analysis to near-instant fiber pricing — positioning Frontier as a data-driven leader in the telecom industry. Since beginning their turnaround in 2021, Frontier has transformed from a legacy telephone company into the largest pure-play fiber internet provider in the country. Frontier now provides access to high-speed, reliable fiber internet connectivity to more than 8 million locations and has achieved industry-leading customer satisfaction.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, self-service queries, and business intelligence for downstream users.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies centralized governance, lineage, and access controls across shared data assets.

data_flow: Customer, product, and engagement data lands in Databricks, is transformed in the lakehouse under Unity Catalog governance, and is served to downstream users and applications through Databricks SQL.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 20% Increase in new logo sales; 40,000+ Contracts analyzed with GenAI.
architecture_clues: Uses Unity Catalog for centralized governance and access control.
